a.lede: The acquisition would bring two major players in on-demand delivery under one roof, combining DoorDash’s dominance in restaurant takeout with Instacart’s reach in grocery delivery.
a.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17B

b.lede: The deal combines the two largest grocery delivery platforms in the US.
b.title: DoorDash acquires Instacart in $17 billion delivery service merger
